justification: Both are stone carvings in low relief that render anthropomorphic forms with schematic headgear, banded garment lines and at least one circular disc motif, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a shallow, finely incised horizontal frieze of repeated profile figures in a processional row, while B is a single massive three-dimensional monolith whose coarse, weathered motifs are stacked vertically on a rounded volume — the format, scale, viewpoint and level of finish are entirely different.
